note: AI summary written on the ground from the simulator figures only (src/sim, Mouad's data). To be validated by the CMO. Never used to decide on an alert.

days.text: Baseline assessment (D0): thigh muscle volume of 2,451 cm³ on the scan. This is the reference for the whole mission. Status: nominal.
Thigh volume at 97.84% of D0 (2,397 cm³), trend −0.58% per week. This is the fastest loss phase, expected early in flight. Status: nominal.
Thigh volume at 96.0% of D0 (2,352 cm³). The trend slows to −0.40% per week. Status: nominal.

Thigh volume at 94.05% of D0 (2,304 cm³), trend −0.32% per week: status: monitor. The alert is based on the 7-day trend, not a single data point. Suggested action: heavy squats and deadlifts on ARED, protein spread through the day.
Projection at Sol 0 (D210) at current pace: 88.77% of D0 volume, status out of limits. A weakened thigh on arrival complicates the first Mars EVAs. Model projection, not a measurement.
Projection at Sol 0 (D210) with the plan followed: 92.17% of D0 volume, status: monitor. The plan gains more than 3 points over the current pace. Model projection, not a measurement.
Projection at return (D860) at current pace: 78.96% of D0 volume, status out of limits. This is the largest loss of all tracked organs. Model projection, not a measurement.

Projection at return (D860) with the plan followed: 88.74% of D0 volume, status out of limits. The plan recovers nearly 10 points, but not enough to return within limits over 860 days. Model projection, not a measurement.
